text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Interior ministry to receive applications until September 14 from people who want to run for the October parliamentary elections.
- Parliament cancels debate due to extraordinary cabinet meeting that dealt with the U.S. missile strike against Iraq.
- People in Kuwait welcome strike against Iraq.
- Oil prices to rise if situation in Iraq remains unchanged, oil minister says.
- Expanded no-fly zone in southern Iraq meets Kuwaiti recommendations, officials and diplomats say.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange ignores military tension.
